aldor: aldor — lord, chief (nominative singular; the same word also means 'life' — see aldorlēase in the prologue)
bryttan: brytta — dispenser, distributor (accusative singular; bēaga brytta 'giver of rings' = generous lord)
bēaga: bēag — of rings (genitive plural; gold arm-rings, the currency of reward)
bēowulf: Bēowulf — Beowulf; here Scyld's son, the Danish king — not the poem's hero (nominative)
cūþe: cunnan — knew, knew how to (3rd singular preterite)
deniga: Dene — of the Danes (genitive plural, longer form; the prologue's Gār-Dena is the same people)
eorla: eorl — of nobles, of warriors (genitive plural; cf. 'earl')
feorran: feorran — from afar, from far back (adverb); at line 156 it is instead the verb feorran 'to remove, put far away' (infinitive)
freân: frēa — lord, king (dative singular, weak; the circumflex marks Klaeber's contraction of the vowels)
frægn: frignan — asked (3rd singular preterite; strong verb, cf. gefrignan)
frēan: frēa — of the Lord (genitive singular of frēa 'lord'; here God) · frēa — lord, king (dative singular, weak; frēan Scyldinga 'to the lord of the Scyldings')
gedriht: gedriht — company, troop of retainers (accusative singular)
gē: gē — you (nominative plural of þū; cf. archaic 'ye')
gēata: Gēatas — Geats, a people of what is now southern Sweden (genitive plural)
gōda: gōd — good (adjective, weak nominative singular masculine; used as a noun, 'the good one')
gūðsearo: gūðsearu — war-gear, battle equipment (accusative; gūð 'battle' + searu 'equipment')
healfdenes: Healfdene — Healfdene, king of the Danes, father of Hrothgar (genitive)
higelāces: Higelāc — Higelac, king of the Geats (genitive)
him: hē — to him, or to them (dative singular or plural of hē) · hē — to himself, for themselves (reflexive dative, pleonastic: gewiton him 'they went off') · hē — to it (neuter dative singular; hīe him tō 'they to it')
hrōðgār: Hrōðgār — Hrothgar, king of the Danes, builder of Heorot (nominative) · Hrōðgār — Hrothgar (accusative; the person taught)
hrōðgāres: Hrōðgār — Hrothgar, king of the Danes, son of Healfdene (genitive)
hwearf: hweorfan — turned, passed, went (3rd singular preterite)
hæleð: hæleð — heroes, men (nominative plural) · hæleð — hero, man (nominative singular)
hȳ: hīe — they (nominative plural; variant spelling of hīe)
lēode: lēode — people, men (nominative plural) · lēode — people, men (accusative plural)
maþelode: maþelian — spoke formally, made a speech (3rd singular preterite; from maþel 'assembly, speech')
men: mann — men (nominative plural) · mann — man (dative singular, umlaut form; gūþmōdgum men 'to the battle-minded man')
mid: mid — with (preposition; here after its object: him mid 'with him') · mid — with (preposition; also before its object: mid Gēatum 'with the Geats')
mē: ic — to me, for me (dative singular of ic; Mǣl is mē 'it is time for me')
mīn: mīn — my (possessive adjective, nominative singular masculine)
nō: nō — not at all, by no means (emphatic negative)
ond: ond — and (the usual spelling of and in this MS)
scildinga: Scyldingas — Scyldings, the Danes, descendants of Scyld (genitive plural)
se: se — the, that (nominative singular masculine; unaccented spelling of sē)
sunu: sunu — son (accusative singular masculine; sunu Healfdenes 'son of Healfdene')
synt: wesan — are (3rd plural present, the forms sint/synt)
syrcan: syrce — mail-shirts (nominative plural, weak feminine; cf. 'sark')
sē: sē — he, that one; the (nominative singular masculine of the demonstrative; sē þe 'he who')
sīde: sīd — wide, broad, ample (adjective, accusative plural masculine)
tō: tō — to, as, for (preposition) · tō — too (adverb; tō swȳð 'too severe') · tō — to (particle before the inflected infinitive: tō gecȳðanne 'for declaring') · tō — to, toward (adverb separated from its goal; tō ... gegnum gangan 'go straight to it') · tō — to (before a bare infinitive: tō fēran 'to go')
wedera: Wederas — Weders, another name for the Geats (genitive plural)
wille: willan — will, wish, intend (1st singular present; ic wille 'I mean to')
wine: wine — friend, friend-and-lord (nominative singular; wine Scyldinga 'friend of the Scyldings')
wið: wið — against; with (preposition; wið Gode 'against God')
wīsade: wīsian — guided, directed (3rd singular preterite; cf. 'wise')
ymb: ymb — after, about, around (preposition; ymb āne niht 'after one night')
þenceð: þencan — thinks, intends (3rd singular present; cf. 'think')
þone: sē — whom, that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, here relative) · sē — that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, qualifying a noun: þone hilderǣs 'that battle-rush')
þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that')
þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative) · when (conjunction)
þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ')
þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people')
þīnne: þīn — your (possessive adjective, accusative singular masculine; hlāford þīnne 'your lord')
þū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun; cf. 'thou')
þǣm: sē — that (dative singular: 'that cargo') · sē — which (dative singular, relative: on þǣm 'in which') · sē — the, that (dative singular masculine, before a weak adjective: tō þǣm mǣran 'to the famous one')
ūs: wē — us, to us (dative plural of wē)
